note: The week on the Special Intensive Revision in a few sentences, written every Friday from the What's new entries of the seven days to that Friday. Each sentence links to the page that carries the fact, with that page's name as the label. Every figure in a sentence is a figure in one of the week's entries, and sources lists the entries each issue draws on.

paragraphs.text: On 29 October the Election Commission moved the final rolls to 30 November in Maharashtra, Haryana, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Nagaland and to 22 December in Delhi, at the request of the Chief Electoral Officers.
paragraphs.label: How the revision was run

paragraphs.text: At the Delhi hearing of 28 October the Supreme Court told the Commission orally not to hold electors to the 30 October cut-off and to keep taking Form 6 and Form 8, without passing a written order.
paragraphs.label: Protests and disputes

paragraphs.text: On 30 October the Supreme Court told the Commission to examine the bulk Form 7 applications in Uttar Pradesh that the petitioners say remain unresolved, and it declined to extend the time for Kerala's revision.
paragraphs.label: Protests and disputes

paragraphs.text: Meghalaya's final roll of 26 October holds 21,83,963 electors, a fall in the roll of 1,65,682, and Karnataka's final roll of 27 October holds 4,54,55,689 general electors, a fall in the roll of 99,76,625.
paragraphs.label: Reserved seats, final rolls and borders

paragraphs.text: Telangana's hearings on notices stood at 92,08,443 on 29 October, with 50,690 electors found ineligible, and Delhi had disposed of 31.2 lakh of its 33.1 lakh notices by 26 October.
paragraphs.label: How the revision was run

paragraphs.text: A box on the help page and on every state's page now says whether claims and objections are open in that state today and when the final roll is due, and the page on how the revision was run now lists the bulk Form 7 filings reported, state by state.
paragraphs.label: Left off the roll? What to do

paragraphs.text: More than 150 people were detained at the People's March in Delhi on 23 October, and the Punjab Assembly's resolution of 23 October, the first by an Assembly, asked for an independent inquiry into alleged irregularities in voter lists.
paragraphs.label: Protests and disputes

paragraphs.text: The INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of the Chief Election Commissioner was put back to 31 October because of rain, and BJP marches run in Rajasthan from 30 October to 5 November and in six Uttar Pradesh regions from 3 to 5 November.
paragraphs.label: Events
